title: MemorySearchOutput
description: What `pdks memory search --json` prints on stdout at exit 0. An empty `results` is a search that found nothing; every failure exits non-zero with nothing on stdout. Objects stay open so a host built against this schema keeps reading a newer command's output.

ingestedAt.description: When the index being searched was last ingested, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

results.description: The matched sections, in the command's ranking order.

MemorySearchResult.description: One section found in the memory index.

id.description: The section id: the document id, `#`, and the heading's slug.

conceptId.description: The id of the document the section belongs to.

status.description: The document's status as its front matter states it.

trust.description: Who verified the document: a human reviewer, a machine, or nobody.

stale.description: Whether the document's `stale_after` date has passed.

matchPath.description: How the query matched: every word, some words, or a substring scan.

supersededBy.description: The documents that directly replace this section's document, sorted; empty when none.
